finalText:
The golden test for footprint area passes now, and the fix was in the code, not the test — the expected 80 m² was correct.

The bug was in `packages/geo-model3d/src/footprint-area.js`: the area loop stopped one edge short and never closed the ring from the last vertex back to the first, so the 10 × 8 rectangle came out as 88 m². The loop now wraps around to include that closing edge.

The full golden suite (117 passed, 3 skipped), the unit suite (1327 passed, 1 skipped) and the type check are all green locally; I did not run the docs, architecture or backlog checks.

Nothing is committed or pushed, so CI stays red until the change lands. This also went in without a backlog row or a `docs/CHORES.md` entry, which `AGENTS.md` requires. Say the word and I'll commit and push, with the chore entry if you want it before the demo.
